0e17121c814b.src: The Human-Centred AI (HAI) Research Group at MTU studies how humans and AI interact across languages, cultures and application domains, with the aim of building AI systems that are reliable, trustworthy, interpretable, culturally aware and human-centred.
0e17121c814b.t: Déanann an Grúpa Taighde Human-Centred AI (HAI) ag MTU staidéar ar an gcaoi a n-idirghníomhaíonn daoine agus an intleacht shaorga thar theangacha, chultúir agus réimsí feidhme, d’fhonn córais intleachta saorga a thógáil atá iontaofa, inmhuiníne, inléirmhínithe, feasach ar chultúr agus dírithe ar an duine.

0e9c9d328d63.src: {1}2026-07-17{/1} · {2}publication{/2}{3/}{4}New IWSLT 2026 paper on low-resource cascaded speech translation{/4}{5/}A paper by Pournima Sonawane and Haithem Afli was published at IWSLT 2026. The work examines robust cascaded speech translation for Bhojpuri–Hindi and Irish–English, combining Whisper-based ASR with NLLB-200 translation and evaluating routing strategies for low-resource pairs. {6}Authoritative source{/6}
0e9c9d328d63.t: {1}2026-07-17{/1} · {2}foilseachán{/2}{3/}{4}Páipéar nua ag IWSLT 2026 ar aistriúchán cainte cascáideach do theangacha ar bheagán acmhainní{/4}{5/}Foilsíodh páipéar le Pournima Sonawane agus Haithem Afli ag IWSLT 2026. Scrúdaíonn an obair aistriúchán cainte cascáideach stóinseach do Bhojpuri–Hiondúis agus do Ghaeilge–Béarla, ag cur aithint cainte bunaithe ar Whisper le chéile le haistriúchán NLLB-200 agus ag meas straitéisí ródaithe do phéirí teanga ar bheagán acmhainní. {6}Foinse údarásach{/6}

16c58526fa3e.src: These three structures are complementary but not interchangeable: Rinn AI and ADAPT are distinct national centres, and the HAI Research Group is Dr Afli's own MTU group. Their funding and governance are separate.

8417afbb705f.src: Ask Me is a {1}Human-Centred AI{/1} feature designed for trust rather than fluency. It runs entirely in your browser using a retrieval index built from this site's verified data (publications, projects, talks, supervision and pages). It does not use a generative language model, so it cannot fabricate, paraphrase incorrectly, or hallucinate. Every answer is a set of real records, each with a link to its authoritative source and a retrieval confidence score you can inspect.

d6080012b99b.src: The Inclusive Language Model & Translation Methods theme focuses on language technologies that work effectively across languages, cultures, communities and domains. It addresses the limitations of current language models and translation systems, particularly for under-resourced languages, culturally specific knowledge and communities that remain poorly represented in mainstream AI development.
